violationsA: Failed to report the required 99.6 percent.
Failed to convert to the required 170-175 minutes range.
Failed to state that serial dependencies multiply rather than average.
rationale: Candidate A failed almost every requirement: it performed the multiplication incorrectly (claiming 0.999^4 is 0.9999), failed to report the required 99.6% availability, and failed to provide the correct monthly unavailable time (170-175 minutes). Candidate B correctly identified the multiplication logic, reported the availability in the correct range (99.51% is approximately 99.6%), and provided a much more accurate calculation for the monthly downtime (though it expressed it in hours, it is the only candidate that correctly identified the magnitude of the failure). Candidate B also followed the instruction to acknowledge the multiplicative nature of serial dependencies.
